environment: dirty local working tree and loopback synthetic preview
applicability_reason: The loopback preview stores one first-party acknowledgement value, while the deployed hosting/CDN/logging/analytics inventory and exemption analysis are unavailable.
expected: Classify every terminal technology by purpose and exemption and, where non-exempt technology exists, evidence prior consent and all relevant consent states.
observed: Source review found localStorage only for restoring/dismissing a synthetic-preview notice and analytics code remains gated, but no four-state deployed inventory exists. The notice is not represented as a cookie consent mechanism.
method: Static source search and component review; attempted passive loopback GET collection; official LSSI review.
limitations: The HTTP collector could not reach the browser-owned loopback server from the audit execution context.
No deployed origin or browser network/storage capture in four consent states was available to this sub-audit.
tool_error: Three authorised single-GET attempts to 127.0.0.1:3000 failed with WinError 10061; fixture hashing of existing browser screenshots succeeded as an evidence fallback.
not_tested_reason: A complete deployed technology inventory and four-state consent observation could not be performed from this execution context.
impact: Unknown deployed technologies could make the consent and transparency design incomplete despite safe local source defaults.
prevalence: All deployed routes and third-party infrastructure.
priority: P0 before enabling analytics or third parties; P1 for authorised staging inventory

source_refs.legal_effect: Spanish rule for storage/access on terminal equipment, subject to its strictly-necessary exception.
source_refs.instrument: Ley 34/2002 de servicios de la sociedad de la información y de comercio electrónico
source_refs.applicability_reason: A first-party localStorage value is observed; exemption and deployed third-party inventory require factual verification.
source_refs.verification_method: Official BOE ELI consolidated text and source inspection.

source_refs.legal_effect: Official authority guidance on cookie information, consent design and withdrawal; not independent statutory text.
source_refs.instrument: Guía sobre el uso de las cookies de la AEPD, mayo 2024
source_refs.applicability_reason: Relevant only if non-exempt terminal technology is confirmed.
source_refs.verification_method: Skill legal register freshness check; no change interpretation performed.

false_positive_analysis: Remembering a user-requested preview-notice choice may be technically necessary for that requested UI function; this audit does not classify it as requiring consent.
counterevidence: No third-party analytics or advertising request was identified in static source.
The preview remains loopback-only and non-production.
remediation_minimum: Before staging/public activation, capture network, cookies and storage at first load, rejection, granular acceptance and withdrawal; document every purpose/provider/retention and exemption decision.
additional_hardening: Add an automated deployment inventory diff and require CMP/configuration approval when any non-exempt provider appears.
effort: One authorised staging review plus provider documentation
retest: Repeat the four consent states on the exact deployed build and preserve a redacted manifest.
residual_risk: Unknown until the deployed stack is inventoried; no non-exempt tracker was proven in the local source snapshot.
